r1:P01: Applied-domain framing outside core machine learning
r1:P03: Explanatory mechanism — says WHY the approach should work
r1:P04: States the costs, limitations, or failure conditions of its own method
r1:P05: Ambition of the claim together with the specificity of the evidence offered for it
r1:P06: Theoretical claims tied to the proposed method with stated scope
r1:P07: Reframing — recasts the problem in a different formalism or abstraction
r1:P09: Motivation explains why the problem is hard, not merely that it is unaddressed
r1:P10: Breadth and diversity of the empirical evaluation actually enumerated
r1:P11: Technical specificity — the method's objects and operations are named precisely
r1:P12: Contributions are separable components each with a stated role
r1:P13: Enumerated list formatting inside the abstract
r1:P14: Raw LaTeX or markup residue left in the abstract
r1:P15: Diagnoses a specific failure mode of prior work with stated evidence
r1:P16: Magnitude of the engineering or data resource the work required
r1:P17: Reports a surprising, negative, or self-undercutting finding
r1:P18: Density of promotional superlatives and hype vocabulary
r1:P19: Generality demonstrated beyond the primary setting rather than asserted
r1:P20: Topic sits in a currently dominant research area
r1:P21: Quantified headline result against a named baseline or prior record
r1:P23: Human or expert judgment used as evaluation evidence
r1:P25: Signals of industrial-scale compute or frontier proprietary models
r2:P01: Discriminative evaluation — designed to decide between hypotheses, not to demonstrate the method
r2:P02: Belief-change — the output is a changed understanding rather than a delivered artifact
r2:P03: Cost stated TOGETHER WITH gain, so the trade is checkable
r2:P04: Limiting result stated TOGETHER WITH the conditions under which it holds
r2:P06: Theory and experiment coupled — the experiments test the theory's own prediction
r2:P08: Precise delta — prior work is characterised specifically enough that the change is checkable
r2:P09: Derivation coupling — the problem's structure is established first and the method is derived from it
r2:P10: Generality of the formal statement TOGETHER WITH concreteness of its instantiation
r2:P11: Syntactic complexity independent of total length
r2:P12: Rhetorical questions posed in the abstract
r2:P13: Restraint — claim language is calibrated BELOW what the reported results would license
r2:P15: Membership in the privacy / security / adversarial-robustness subfield
r2:P16: Subsumption — prior work is exhibited as special cases of a more general statement
r2:P17: Reusable artifact — what is left behind is fit for others to build on, judged scale-free
r2:P18: Mechanistic explanation of an OBSERVED fact, not of the proposed method
r2:P19: Simplicity of the solution RELATIVE TO the difficulty of the problem it solves
r2:P20: Names and characterises a phenomenon that did not previously have a name
r2:P21: Insight portability — the finding would survive replacing the specific benchmark it was shown on
r2:P23: Typographic emphasis used inside the abstract
r2:P25: Inline author-year citations inside the abstract
